incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-metering-service detected token_count delta > 30% vs baseline for customer-facing emit pipeline (region: us-east-1). auto-escalation to #incidents. PID: metering-emit-3
oncall-alex: ack. I’m oncall for the next 40m. adding triage notes.
oncall-alex: quick check — is this all customers or a subset? any overage flags firing?
sre-maya: looks like it’s a subset — top-10 customers by spend showing delayed emits and some duplicated counts. dashboards: https://dash.internal/redwood/metering/token-delta?range=15m
sre-maya: snippets from the log stream: ```WARN metering.emitter - last_emit_ts gap=00:02:13 queue_lag=1243 tokens_emitted=0 expected=1423```
oncall-alex: thanks. billing-ops, can you confirm whether billing downstream saw late batches? any alert on overage flags?
billing-ops: we saw a surge in overage flags at ~1729887000, some customers got temporary notify emails. digging into emitter offsets now.
evans: pinging the embed/ingest team — I see the emit-worker restarted twice around 1729886905, might be OOM fallback. logs: ```OOMKilled process=emit-worker-3 container=runtime-v2```
tara: I’m seeing KV cache invalidation on that host; when the worker restarted it replayed a small batch and then resumed, but replay batching is small — could cause duplicate counts during replay window.
sre-maya: hypothesis: worker restarts + in-flight prefix cache loss => duplicate replay + delayed emits => counts drift. mitigation options: 1) throttle emit retries, 2) enable dedupe window by ingest id for 5m, 3) route requests to warm pool.
oncall-alex: priority: stop customer-visible overage flags and reduce duplicates. which is fastest?
billing-ops: quickest is to flip the metric-check that generates overage alerts to use the shadow counts (shadow pipeline) instead of live for thresholds. patching alert runbook now.

sre-maya: rolling a short-lived config change: set ALERT_SOURCE=shadow_counts for billing-threshold-checker. doing canary now. ```kubectl -n billing set env deploy/threshold-checker ALERT_SOURCE=shadow_counts --record```

sre-maya: canary looks good for the next 2m; no new overage notifications since flip :thumbsup:

cust-success-jon: looping in CS — which customers were notified? I want to message them.
billing-ops: initial list: cust-omega, cust-sparrow, cust-luma (email batch sent). I’ll hand off the accurate list in 10m.
evans: for duplication mitigation, we can enable dedupe by ingest_id at the aggregator for 10m backfill. command to run (dry-run first): ```python tools/backfill_dedupe.py --env prod --lookback 10m --dry-run```

migue: heads up, dedupe backfill increases CPU usage on aggregator; if we run during peak may impact latency. recommend run on single replica then scale.
oncall-alex: accepted. plan: 1) keep alert source on shadow_counts (billing notifications paused) 2) run dry-run dedupe + verify delta 3) run dedupe on one replica 4) scale aggregator if needed 5) full backfill if delta confirmed.
tara: prepping playbook snippet for CS message: "We identified a transient emitter restart that caused some duplicates and delayed reports. We have paused overage notifications and are reconciling counts. No billing changes will be made until recon confirms net delta."
cust-success-jon: good. I’ll send a calm notice to affected customers once we confirm the list.
sre-maya: dry-run results: predicted duplicate delta ~ +0.8% for cust-omega, +2.1% for cust-sparrow. logs show replayed segments had overlapping seq ranges.
evans: starting real dedupe on aggregator-1 now. command: ```python tools/backfill_dedupe.py --env prod --lookback 10m```

sre-maya: aggregator-1 completed, delta reduced. running aggregator-2 next. monitoring metrics: token_emit_rate normalizing, queue_lag decreasing.
billing-ops: confirmed overage notification pipeline paused; we will not retroactively bill for the duplicated tokens until final reconciled report.
oncall-alex: time check — 30m into incident. I’m handing off oncall to @sre-maya for the next 2h for stabilization. adding Handoff: incident summary, mitigation steps, customer list, runbook link: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/metering-drift
sre-maya: ack takeover. I’ll stay on until postmortem ownership sorted.
cust-success-jon: draft message for customers ready, will send after final reconciliation.
tara: final check: run final reconcile job and snapshot counts. command: ```/usr/local/bin/reconcile_counts --since 1729886600 --output /tmp/recon-1729888210.json```
sre-maya: reconcile done. net system delta = +0.01% across all customers (within noise). specific adjustments for cust-sparrow were -5 tokens after dedupe (not billing-impact).
billing-ops: marking incident resolved for customer impact. we’ll keep billing notifications paused until midnight UTC to ensure no flapping.
oncall-alex: thanks everyone. postmortem: owner: sre-maya, timeline + root cause: emitter process restarts + KV cache invalidation causing small replay overlap, mitigation: pause overage notifications, dedupe backfill, scale aggregator.
sre-maya: will file postmortem and include automation to disable overage alerts automatically when emitter restarts more than 1x/min.
cust-success-jon: sent customer follow-ups with explanation and reassurance. customers acknowledged. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident closed by sre-maya at 1729888210.
